doc.title: Wayne Andre interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 7, 2002

chapter: Manhattan School and the Benny Goodman Russian tour
title: Goodman and Joe Wilder
summary: Goodman hassled Joe Wilder over luggage and pay on the State Department tour.

story.theme_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the leader and his bands
story.community_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the perfectionist bandleader

blocks.x: Well I know one trumpet player that was on that tour who will not say the name Benny Goodman, he was so upset at how that tour went that — he’ll say —

Well he treated Joe really badly. His reason for treating Joe badly was that Benny has this crazy way of thinking that somebody’s using him. And Joe had a lot of excess luggage due to the fact that he was going from Russia to Sweden to meet his wife, because she’s Swedish and he wasn’t coming home, so he had all this luggage he was carrying around or something, I’m not quite sure.

But there was some hostility over this and Benny was kind of rubbing him, trying to deduct money from his pay for overweight luggage and all kinds of stuff and it was so dumb because the government was paying it all. The United States government was paying this thing. It was a State Department tour. It wasn’t a free enterprise thing sponsored by Benny Goodman or a producer or something. And I’ve never heard Joe Wilder in my life swear, but I heard him swear behind me on that trip. Not anything really profane, but —
But Joe was sitting right in back of me you know.
I mean there’s other stories I could tell you, it was so dark I don’t even want to go there.
